NAME

acip_security

SYNOPSIS

#include <include/ascii-chat/network/acip/security.h>

crypto_handshake_context_t handshake
uint8_t mode
bool forbid_encryption
bool require_encryption
bool version_received
bool parameters_received
bool ready

Detailed Description

Per-peer, event-driven negotiation. The caller owns and configures handshake. Callers serialize receive/start and keep the transport alive until cleanup. Media must wait for ready, including authentication-only connections.
